response:
Assuming your message asks:

> **"How many minutes are there in one full day?"**

There are **1,440 minutes** in one full day.

$$\text{24 hours} \times \text{60 minutes/hour} = \mathbf{1{,}440\text{ minutes}}$$

---

*(If you meant seconds: $1{,}440 \times 60 = \mathbf{86{,}400\text{ seconds}}$.)*
